<script type="text/x-dc" data-dc-script data-props='{"motion":{"editor":"enum","options":["once","loop","off"],"default":"once"},"$preview":{"width":390,"height":5100}}'>
class Component extends DCLogic {
state = { step: 0, focus: '' };
_t = [];
replay = () => this.play();
pickPrice = () => this.pick('price');
pickMaterials = () => this.pick('materials');
pickWarranty = () => this.pick('warranty');
componentDidMount() { this.play(); }
componentDidUpdate(prev) { if (prev.motion !== this.props.motion) this.play(); }
componentWillUnmount() { this.clear(); }
clear() { this._t.forEach((id) => clearTimeout(id)); this._t = []; }
pick(name) { this.clear(); this.setState({ step: 4, focus: name }); }
play() {
this.clear();
const mode = this.props.motion ?? 'once';
const calm = typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
if (mode === 'off' || calm) { this.setState({ step: 4, focus: '' }); return; }
this.setState({ step: 0, focus: '' });
this._t.push(setTimeout(() => this.setState({ step: 1 }), 600));
this._t.push(setTimeout(() => this.setState({ step: 2 }), 1700));
this._t.push(setTimeout(() => this.setState({ step: 3 }), 2800));
this._t.push(setTimeout(() => this.setState({ step: 4 }), 4200));
if (mode === 'loop') this._t.push(setTimeout(() => this.play(), 7000));
}
renderVals() {
const s = this.state.step;
const f = this.state.focus;
const word = (n) => ({ display: 'inline-block', opacity: s >= n ? 1 : 0, transform: s >= n ? 'translateY(0)' : 'translateY(8px)', transition: 'opacity 0.45s ease, transform 0.45s ease' });
const hot = (n, name) => (f ? f === name : s === n);
const row = (n, name) => ({ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1.25fr 1fr 1fr 1fr', gap: '8px', alignItems: 'center', padding: '13px 12px', borderTop: '1px solid #DCE2E8', background: hot(n, name) ? '#FBD38D' : (s >= n ? '#FFF4DC' : '#FFFFFF'), transition: 'background 0.45s ease' });
const tab = (n, name) => { const on = hot(n, name); return { height: '48px', padding: '0 14px', font: 'inherit', fontSize: '15px', fontWeight: 600, cursor: 'pointer', borderRadius: '24px', border: '2px solid #0D1B2E', background: on ? '#0D1B2E' : '#FFFFFF', color: on ? '#FFFFFF' : '#0D1B2E', transition: 'background 0.3s ease, color 0.3s ease' }; };
const lines = { price: 'Price: we submit one scope of work to multiple contractors.', materials: 'Materials: learn about the benefits of upgraded materials without being sold on them.', warranty: 'Warranty: we help you learn the difference between warranties so you can assess the real value of what contractors offer.' };
return {
w1: word(1), w2: word(2), w3: word(3),
rowPrice: row(1, 'price'), rowMaterials: row(2, 'materials'), rowWarranty: row(3, 'warranty'),
tabPrice: tab(1, 'price'), tabMaterials: tab(2, 'materials'), tabWarranty: tab(3, 'warranty'),
explain: f ? lines[f] : 'Sample layout. Your bids appear here, side by side.',
replay: this.replay, pickPrice: this.pickPrice, pickMaterials: this.pickMaterials, pickWarranty: this.pickWarranty
};
}
}
</script>
</body>
</html>
